Found one that would've hit review immediately: **`RecordView`'s content and the shared `ContentUnavailableStateView`** (used by Timeline's empty state, all three of Search's empty states, and Entry Detail's unavailable state) were both a fixed `VStack` with `Spacer()`s and no scroll container — fine at default text size, but a hard violation of the "never clip, always scroll/reflow" rule the moment Dynamic Type hits an accessibility size on a compact device (SE-class screens). Fixed both with the `GeometryReader` + `ScrollView` + `.frame(minHeight:)` idiom — behaves identically to the old fixed layout at normal sizes (Spacers still center everything), but scrolls instead of clipping the Done button or action button off-screen under stress. Fixing it once in the shared component protects every screen that reuses it, rather than patching four call sites separately.
